source: nodes.output_schema, catalog_scope global, app attio, node_status active

ObjectId.title: ObjectId

object_id.title: Object Id
object_id.description: A UUID to identify the object

workspace_id.title: Workspace Id
workspace_id.description: A UUID to identify the workspace this object belongs to

ObjectId.description: Model representing the nested ID structure

ObjectMetadata.title: ObjectMetadata

id.title: Id
id.description: The unique identifier structure of the object

api_slug.title: Api Slug
api_slug.description: A unique, human-readable slug to access the object through URLs and API calls. Formatted in snake case. Can be null.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: When the object was created (ISO 8601 timestamp format)

plural_noun.title: Plural Noun
plural_noun.description: The plural form of the object's name. Can be null.

singular_noun.title: Singular Noun
singular_noun.description: The singular form of the object's name. Can be null.

ObjectMetadata.description: Model representing metadata for an individual object

objects.title: Objects
objects.description: List of objects with their metadata

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not

values.title: Values
values.description: Object containing attribute values keyed by attribute API slug. Each attribute maps to an array of value objects.

web_url.title: Web Url
web_url.description: Direct URL to view the record in the Attio web application.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with nanosecond precision indicating when the record was created.

id.title: Id
id.description: Composite ID of the option containing workspace_id, object_id, attribute_id, and option_id.

id.title: Id
id.description: UUID of the actor, or null for certain system actors.

type.title: Type
type.description: Type of actor: 'api-token', 'workspace-member', 'system', or 'app'. May be null for certain system actors.

value.title: Value
value.description: The actual value for simple attribute types (text, number, checkbox, date, timestamp, rating, currency). Type depends on attribute_type: string for text/date/timestamp, number for number/rating/currency, boolean for checkbox.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: For domain attributes: Full domain name.

line_1.title: Line 1
line_1.description: For location attributes: First line of the address.

line_2.title: Line 2
line_2.description: For location attributes: Second line of the address.

line_3.title: Line 3
line_3.description: For location attributes: Third line of the address.

line_4.title: Line 4
line_4.description: For location attributes: Fourth line of the address.

option.title: Option
option.description: For select and status attributes: The selected option object.

region.title: Region
region.description: For location attributes: State, province, or region.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: For location attributes: Geographic latitude coordinate.

locality.title: Locality
locality.description: For location attributes: City or locality.

postcode.title: Postcode
postcode.description: For location attributes: Postal or ZIP code.

full_name.title: Full Name
full_name.description: For personal-name attributes: Full name of the person.

last_name.title: Last Name
last_name.description: For personal-name attributes: Last name of the person.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: For location attributes: Geographic longitude coordinate.

first_name.title: First Name
first_name.description: For personal-name attributes: First name of the person.

active_from.title: Active From
active_from.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when this value became active.

owner_actor.title: Owner Actor
owner_actor.description: For interaction attributes: Actor who owns the interaction.

root_domain.title: Root Domain
root_domain.description: For domain attributes: Root domain name.

active_until.title: Active Until
active_until.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when this value expires, or null if still active.

country_code.title: Country Code
country_code.description: For phone-number and location attributes: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

email_domain.title: Email Domain
email_domain.description: For email-address attributes: Full domain part of the email.

currency_code.title: Currency Code
currency_code.description: For currency attributes: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR').

email_address.title: Email Address
email_address.description: For email-address attributes: Normalized email address.

interacted_at.title: Interacted At
interacted_at.description: For interaction attributes: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the interaction occurred.

target_object.title: Target Object
target_object.description: For record-reference attributes: API slug of the referenced object type (e.g., 'people', 'companies').

created_by_actor.title: Created By Actor
created_by_actor.description: Reference to the actor (user, API token, or system) that created this value.

interaction_type.title: Interaction Type
interaction_type.description: For interaction attributes: Type of interaction ('calendar-event', 'call', 'chat-thread', 'email', 'in-person-meeting', 'meeting').

target_record_id.title: Target Record Id
target_record_id.description: For record-reference attributes: UUID of the referenced record.

email_root_domain.title: Email Root Domain
email_root_domain.description: For email-address attributes: Root domain part of the email.

referenced_actor_id.title: Referenced Actor Id
referenced_actor_id.description: For actor-reference attributes: UUID of the referenced actor, or null for system actors.

email_local_specifier.title: Email Local Specifier
email_local_specifier.description: For email-address attributes: Local part of the email (before @).

original_phone_number.title: Original Phone Number
original_phone_number.description: For phone-number attributes: Phone number as inputted by the user.

referenced_actor_type.title: Referenced Actor Type
referenced_actor_type.description: For actor-reference attributes: Type of actor ('workspace-member', 'api-token', 'system').

original_email_address.title: Original Email Address
original_email_address.description: For email-address attributes: Email as originally input without normalization.

normalized_phone_number.title: Normalized Phone Number
normalized_phone_number.description: For phone-number attributes: Phone number in E.164 format as set by Attio.

data.title: Data
data.description: Array of record objects matching the query criteria.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not
